title: Apply for the household National Energy Bill Relief payment
summary: Find out about the National Energy Bill Relief payment available to NSW households to help with electricity costs.
intro:
The Australian Government has announced that all NSW households are eligible for up to $150 to help with the cost of their electricity bills in the 2025-26 financial year.

Most households will receive their Bill Relief payment automatically from their electricity provider in two quarterly instalments of $75 on their electricity bill from 31 July 2025 and 1 October 2025.
who_can_apply: All NSW households are eligible for up to $150 in National Energy Bill Relief for the 2025-26 financial year.
